defects.detail: Guest Account fell through to legacy long menu; preferences/verification remained inline. Public Account now uses approved signed-out design and action fields open focused sheets.

Keyboard sheet double compensation hid fields. KeyboardAvoidingView now owns compensation; nested ScrollView automatic keyboard insets disabled and sheet/scroll can shrink. Reopen/focus retest shows input and Continue above keyboard.

At enlarged phone text, absolute cylinder artwork overlapped banner copy. Below600pt and fontScale>1.15 the artwork now follows the text in flow, preserving default approved composition. Actual text-size6 Home/refill retest passed.
